text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the AI Engineer Intern position at Northwind Analytics. As a Computer Science and Engineering student at the Pune Institute of Technology with hands-on experience in machine learning and backend development, I am eager to contribute to your team.

During my recent internship as a Machine Learning Intern at Brightcart Retail Analytics, I built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over 4,000 product manuals using Python, FastAPI, and pgvector. To ensure high quality, I wrote an evaluation set of 150 questions and successfully raised answer accuracy from 71% to 86% by tuning chunk size and prompts. Additionally, I containerised the service with Docker and deployed it on a company virtual machine. 

Beyond my internship, I developed StudyBuddy, an application that generates AI flashcards from lecture notes using Python, the Gemini API, and React. The system produces structured JSON output validated by Pydantic and was used by 120 classmates during end-semester exams. My technical toolkit includes Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, PostgreSQL, and Docker, complemented by my academic foundation and my experience as a finalist in the Smart India Hackathon 2025.

Although your requirements mention skills such as vector databases and building APIs, my practical work with pgvector, FastAPI, and evaluation sets has prepared me to hit the ground running. I am keen to learn new tools as needed and contribute effectively to Northwind Analytics.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background aligns with your internship program.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
